name: Lithophane sphere V2
description: A thin-walled sphere with a circular opening on top (Vessel panel): an exact, smooth sphere outside and a structured, deep subdivision relief inside - pure weights, no noise. Iteration 1 pushes the faces out and pulls the corners in, 2 sinks the edges into ribs, 3 swells the panels, 4 alternates faces and edges into nested coffers, 5 adds fine ribbing. The furthest-reaching panels press against the shell as thin windows (glowing share 15%), so lit from inside it reads like a rose window. Edit the weights as on any form; use the Section view to watch the relief and Light preview for the glow. Print upside down on the rim (the Print panel does this and exports the mesh exactly).
